nfa273800b99.s: Vertical fiscal imbalance in India arises mainly because:
o: The Union has the more buoyant taxes while States carry heavier spending duties
The States have the more buoyant taxes while the Union carries heavier spending duties
Some States have higher per capita income than others
The Union and the States have identical tax bases
nfa273800b99.x: The Centre controls the more buoyant taxes, while States bear major spending duties such as health, education, agriculture and police.

ncd6a5501885.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: State Finance Commission – constituted by the Governor
Union Finance Commission – constituted by the Governor
ncd6a5501885.x: The State Finance Commission is constituted by the Governor under Article 243I; the Union Finance Commission is constituted by the President under Article 280.

n471497412cd.s: Which new criterion of the 16th Finance Commission, carrying 10% weight, helped Andhra Pradesh's share?
n471497412cd.x: The new contribution-to-GDP criterion carried a 10% weight and helped Andhra Pradesh's share by recognising its economic contribution.

n987ccff8a91.s: Andhra Pradesh's 'prosperity paradox' in tax devolution arises under which criterion?
n987ccff8a91.x: Income distance gives greater weight to States with lower per capita GSDP, so Andhra Pradesh's above-average per capita income works against it.

n79d14c5a324.s: Which change is associated with the Sixteenth Finance Commission award for 2026–31?
o: GDP criterion added; revenue-deficit grants continued
Tax-effort criterion added; revenue-deficit grants dropped
GDP criterion added; revenue-deficit grants dropped
GDP criterion dropped; revenue-deficit grants doubled
n79d14c5a324.x: The 2026–31 award adds a GDP criterion and drops revenue-deficit grants.

n11660d7d1ba.s: AMRUT 2.0 specifically rewards urban local bodies for:
n11660d7d1ba.x: AMRUT 2.0 rewards progress in property-tax reform and resource mobilisation through municipal bonds.

n53f9830a422.s:
With reference to MPLADS, consider the following statements:
1. The Member of Parliament recommends works, which the Implementing District Authority executes.
2. RTI applies to works under the scheme.
3. The Member of Parliament executes the works directly.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n53f9830a422.x: Under MPLADS the MP only recommends works and the Implementing District Authority executes them; RTI applies and eSAKSHI is the associated portal.

n017a85fc267.s: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA), begun in 2018-19, strengthens Panchayati Raj Institutions mainly for achieving:
n017a85fc267.x: RGSA aims to strengthen PRIs so that they can contribute to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.

ndd2d72c26d9.s: A major concern about State Finance Commission reports is that they are:
o: Prepared by the Union Finance Commission
ndd2d72c26d9.x: State Finance Commission reports are often ignored, which weakens fiscal devolution to local bodies.

na6c9837451c.s: The Model Code of Conduct rests on which provision, and applies from when?
o: Article 324; from the announcement of the election schedule
Article 324; from the start of polling
Representation of the People Act, 1951; from the announcement of the schedule
Representation of the People Act, 1951; from the declaration of results
na6c9837451c.x: The MCC is not a statute; it rests on Article 324 and applies from the announcement of the election schedule (Harbans Singh Jalal, 1997).

na5d2f67105e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 329(a) – Challenge to an election only by election petition
Article 329(b) – Bar on questioning delimitation in court
Article 71 – Disputes on Presidential and Vice-Presidential elections
na5d2f67105e.x: Article 71 covers disputes on Presidential and Vice-Presidential elections; 329(a) bars court challenges to delimitation and 329(b) requires an election petition.

n68ccff7b654.s: Two Election Commissioners were added in 1989 after which Amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18?
n68ccff7b654.x: The 61st Amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18, after which two Election Commissioners were added in 1989.

nb3ed9d476ee.s: With reference to the Election Commission of India, which pair is correctly matched?
nb3ed9d476ee.x: The Golden Jubilee was observed in 2001; the Diamond Jubilee was in 2010 and 75 years were completed in 2025.

nfedfafefb28.s:
Regarding the Selection Committee under the CEC and Other ECs Act, 2023, consider:
1. It may select names outside the Search Committee's shortlist.
2. It recommends names for appointment by the President.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nfedfafefb28.x: The Selection Committee may choose names outside the Search Committee's shortlist, and it recommends names to the President for appointment.

n1761cb19f4f.s: At the district level, Returning and Presiding Officers are appointed by the:
n1761cb19f4f.x: Each State has a Chief Electoral Officer, while at district level the Collector/District Election Officer appoints Returning and Presiding Officers.

n5c715ac13fd.s: Which of the following does the Constitution NOT prescribe for members of the Election Commission?
o: Removal of the CEC in the manner of a Supreme Court judge
Superintendence of elections vested in the Commission
n5c715ac13fd.x: The Constitution prescribes no qualifications and no fixed term for members of the Election Commission.

n783fee3baee.s: An election petition on a Parliamentary or State Legislature election is tried by the ____, with appeal to the ____.
n783fee3baee.x: Such election petitions are tried by the High Court, and an appeal lies to the Supreme Court.

n9119d5fdc21.s: Which type of revision rebuilds the electoral roll comprehensively?
n9119d5fdc21.x: A Special Intensive Revision rebuilds the electoral roll, whereas summary revision is conducted annually.

n632b445cc98.s: Under Article 326, a citizen aged 18 or above may be disqualified from voting on grounds of:
o: Non-residence, unsoundness of mind, crime or corrupt practice
n632b445cc98.x: Article 326 grants adult suffrage subject to disqualifications such as non-residence, unsoundness of mind, crime and corrupt or illegal practice.

nindian-polity-53-4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The right to vote is a Fundamental Right.
2. The right to contest an election is a statutory right.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-53-4.x: The right to vote is statutory, not fundamental; the right to contest is also statutory (Kuldip Nayar, 2006).

n8801c761f9e.s: Under the Delimitation Act of 1972, the Delimitation Commission was constituted in:
n8801c761f9e.x: The Delimitation Acts were enacted in 1952, 1962, 1972 and 2002; the Commissions were constituted in 1952, 1963, 1973 and 2002.

nf983c037c26.s: Readjustment of State Legislative Assembly constituencies after each census is provided under:
nf983c037c26.x: Article 170 provides for readjustment of Assembly constituencies; Article 82 does so for the Lok Sabha and Article 81(2) embodies uniformity of representation.

naf3e34ecb2d.s: Which of the following pairs (Lok Sabha – year of election) is correctly matched?
naf3e34ecb2d.x: The 1st, 9th, 11th and 16th Lok Sabhas were elected in 1952, 1989, 1996 and 2014 respectively.

n7eb91dd8d9b.s: The increase in Andhra Pradesh–Telangana seats under Section 26 awaits:
n7eb91dd8d9b.x: The seat increase under Section 26 awaits the census conducted after 2026.

nindian-polity-38-18.s:
Consider the following statements about delimitation:
1. It redraws territorial constituency boundaries on the basis of recent census figures.
2. It is intended to ensure equal representation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-38-18.x: Delimitation redraws boundaries using recent census figures so that each seat has roughly equal population.

nda83e987de1.s: The age threshold for senior citizens in the absentee-voter postal ballot category is:
nda83e987de1.x: The senior-citizen threshold is 85 years or above, raised from 80 years.

nea61087cef0.s: Southern States fear population-based delimitation would shift Lok Sabha seats towards States such as:
nea61087cef0.x: Population-based delimitation would shift representation towards more populous States such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Rajasthan.

n2633ea1c843.s: The NOTA symbol, a ballot paper with a black cross, was designed by:
o: The National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad
n2633ea1c843.x: The NOTA symbol was designed by NID Ahmedabad; it was first used in a Lok Sabha election in 2014.

nb4afc0e5df4.s: From 1 July 2024, electoral offences such as bribery, undue influence and personation are contained in:
nb4afc0e5df4.x: From 1 July 2024 these offences are in Chapter IX of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (Sections 169–177); earlier they were in IPC Chapter IXA.

n91e388501c2.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: NOTA first used in a Lok Sabha general election – 2013
n91e388501c2.x: VVPAT was first used at Noksen in 2013; EVMs were first used at Parur in 1982 and NOTA in a Lok Sabha general election in 2014.

nindian-polity-66-16.s:
Consider the following statements about NOTA:
1. Exercising NOTA is active participation in the electoral process.
2. NOTA is equivalent to abstention.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-66-16.x: Using NOTA is voting, by registering a negative choice; it is not the same as abstaining.

n770e12ae54d.s:
With reference to Article 329, consider the following statements:
1. An election can be challenged only by an election petition.
2. Laws relating to delimitation cannot be questioned in any court.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n770e12ae54d.x: Article 329 bars courts from questioning delimitation laws and allows an election to be challenged only through an election petition.

ncc134ca5534.s: The six-month requirement for holding a by-election does NOT apply when:
o: The vacancy arises in a reserved constituency
The vacancy arises from the resignation of the member
The remaining term is less than one year
The vacancy arises during a session of the House
ncc134ca5534.x: The exceptions are a remaining term of less than one year, or the Election Commission certifying difficulty after consulting the Central Government.

n0cf5faef09c.s: The bar on opinion polls during the 48 hours before the close of poll is provided under which Section of the RPA, 1951?
n0cf5faef09c.x: Section 126 bars opinion polls in the 48 hours before the close of poll; Section 126A governs the longer restriction on exit polls.

n1e9a19471c0.s: The High Court should endeavour to decide an election petition within:
n1e9a19471c0.x: The High Court should try to decide an election petition within six months, and an appeal lies to the Supreme Court.

nindian-polity-36-5.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Election disputes are adjudicated exclusively by the judiciary through election petitions.
2. Disputes on Presidential and Vice-Presidential elections are decided by the Election Commission.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-36-5.x: Election disputes go only to the courts; Presidential and Vice-Presidential election disputes go to the Supreme Court under Article 71, not the ECI.

n7720bc60e02.s: The NETA app, which lets voters rate their elected representatives, was built by:
o: The Ministry of Law and Justice
n7720bc60e02.x: The NETA app was built by a private start-up; it was not conceptualised by the Election Commission of India.

n95a0bbaf615.s: Under the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the ban on exit polls is provided in:
n95a0bbaf615.x: Section 126A of the RPA, 1951 concerns the ban on exit polls.

n1e274c1f30c.s: The Law Commission's 170th Report found full state funding of elections desirable only if:
o: Only recognised parties were allowed to contest
Parties were barred from taking funds from other sources
Independent candidates were excluded from funding
n1e274c1f30c.x: The Law Commission considered full state funding desirable only if parties were barred from receiving funds from other sources.

nindian-polity-53-27.s:
Which of the following were recommended by the Dinesh Goswami Committee?
1. State funding of elections
2. Use of Electronic Voting Machines
3. Allocation of State Legislative Council seats
Select the correct answer:
nindian-polity-53-27.x: The Goswami Committee recommended State funding of elections and EVMs, leading to the 1996 RPA amendment; Council seat allocation was not its subject.

n23e870ce7e5.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the RPA, 1951 is correctly matched?
n23e870ce7e5.x: Section 33A concerns disclosure of criminal antecedents; Section 8 is disqualification on conviction, 29A registration of parties and 123 corrupt practices.

n613e2fbb641.s: Barring candidates upon framing of charges in serious offences was recommended by which Law Commission report?
n613e2fbb641.x: The recommendation was made in the Law Commission's 244th Report of 2014.

na6e02e56268.s:
On criminalisation of politics, consider the following statements:
1. A PIL seeking a lifetime ban on convicted legislators is pending.
2. 12 special courts have been set up for cases involving MPs and MLAs.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na6e02e56268.x: A PIL seeking a lifetime ban on convicted legislators is pending, and 12 special courts have been established for cases involving MPs and MLAs.

n75f7b40d113.s: The Second Administrative Reforms Commission recommended:
o: Full state funding and a lifetime ban on convicted legislators
Partial state funding and barring persons charged with serious offences
Simultaneous elections and a constructive no-confidence motion
n75f7b40d113.x: The Second ARC recommended partial state funding and barring persons charged with serious offences.

nindian-polity-73-4.s: The nationwide rollout of Electors Photo Identity Cards was initiated in 1993 under CEC:
nindian-polity-73-4.x: The nationwide EPIC rollout began in 1993 under Chief Election Commissioner T.N. Seshan.

nindian-polity-73-10.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-polity-73-10.x: VVPAT was introduced on 4 September 2013; EVMs were first used on 19 May 1982, EPIC rolled out in 1993 and NOTA on 27 September 2013.

n147b8bc01c6.s: An M3 EVM control unit can connect up to how many ballot units?
n147b8bc01c6.x: An M3 system can take up to 24 ballot units (384 candidates including NOTA), whereas M2 supports four ballot units and 64 candidates.

n4d43c7d2230.s: The Election Commission capped the number of electors per polling station at:
n4d43c7d2230.x: The Election Commission capped electors per polling station at 1,200 and delisted 808 RUPPs.

nf85a89910a9.s: Which of the following pairs (Party – Founder) is correctly matched?
o: Bharatiya Jana Sangh – Syama Prasad Mookerjee
nf85a89910a9.x: The Bharatiya Jana Sangh was founded by Syama Prasad Mookerjee (1951); the DMK by C.N. Annadurai and the Swatantra Party by C. Rajagopalachari.

neefcb1f3f6c.s: The YSRCP emerged in 2011 from a split in which party?
neefcb1f3f6c.x: The YSRCP emerged from a Congress split in 2011; the TDP was founded by NTR in 1982.

n8ace6da731a.s: India's multi-party system mainly reflects political divisions along the lines of:
o: Region, language, caste, religion and class
n8ace6da731a.x: India's multi-party system reflects divisions based on region, language, caste, religion and class.

n7fcde3f3617.s: The electoral bond scheme was struck down in which case and on what date?
o: ADR v. Union of India, 15 February 2023
PUCL v. Union of India, 15 February 2024
ADR v. Union of India, 15 February 2024
Common Cause v. Union of India, 15 February 2024
n7fcde3f3617.x: The electoral bond scheme was struck down in ADR v. Union of India on 15 February 2024.

n3f5eea0f8bd.s: Which of the following pairs (Term/work – Scholar) is correctly matched?
o: Party Building in a New Nation – Rajni Kothari
n3f5eea0f8bd.x: Rajni Kothari coined 'Congress system'; Morris-Jones described 'one-party dominance' and Myron Weiner wrote Party Building in a New Nation.

nindian-polity-54-8.s: Who coined the term 'Congress System' or 'One-Party Dominant System'?
nindian-polity-54-8.x: Political scientist Rajni Kothari coined 'Congress system' for the post-independence pattern of one-party dominance.

n39eb984647c.s: Which general election marked the beginning of the coalition era in the States?
n39eb984647c.x: The 1967 election ended Congress rule in several States and began the coalition era in the States.

nd09cad53aaf.s: As per the APPSC (2007) key, which general election marked the end of Congress dominance?
nd09cad53aaf.x: Per the APPSC 2007 key, after the 1969 split the umbrella Congress system gave way to Indira Gandhi's personalised politics in the 1971 election.

nefd506edc17.s: The first non-Congress government at the Centre, formed in 1977, was headed by:
nefd506edc17.x: The Janata Party formed the first non-Congress government at the Centre in 1977 with Morarji Desai as Prime Minister.

n9e95238c807.s: In the 2014 Lok Sabha election, the BJP won how many of the 543 seats, the first single-party majority since 1984?
n9e95238c807.x: The BJP won 282 of 543 seats in 2014, the first single-party majority since 1984.

nbcda20b2c8c.s: The multi-party era of 1989–2014 ended with:
o: Formation of the United Front in 1996
The BJP winning a majority on its own in 2014
nbcda20b2c8c.x: The 1989–2014 multi-party era ended when the BJP won a majority on its own in 2014.

n2a7022d7269.s: The Justice Party-era awakening of which group laid the base for regional parties in Andhra?
n2a7022d7269.x: The awakening of non-Brahmin agrarian castes in the Justice Party era laid the social base for regional parties in Andhra.

nindian-polity-54-10.s: Which general election marked the end of the 'Congress System'?
nindian-polity-54-10.x: The 1989 general election ended the Congress system and began the era of minority and coalition governments.

n7f347d80a04.s: Who headed the minority Congress government that completed a full term from 1991 to 1996?
n7f347d80a04.x: P.V. Narasimha Rao headed the minority Congress government of 1991–96, which completed its full term.

n652050ff420.s: The NDA government led by A.B. Vajpayee, a coalition of parties with no earlier experience of working together, governed during:
n652050ff420.x: The Vajpayee-led NDA governed from 1998 to 2004 and brought together parties with no prior experience of working together.

n70a6ac82cc3.s: Kerala's bipolar party system is a contest between the:
n70a6ac82cc3.x: Kerala is characterised by a bipolar contest between the United Democratic Front and the Left Democratic Front.

n633d9fdca3e.s: Which of the following pairs (Party – Founder) is correctly matched?
o: Biju Janata Dal – Lalu Prasad Yadav
n633d9fdca3e.x: The DMK was founded in Tamil Nadu by C.N. Annadurai in 1949; the other pairs interchange founders.

n8bef71a9bdf.s: In coalition politics, regional parties have often acted as ____, supplying Speakers, Union Ministers and survival votes.
n8bef71a9bdf.x: Regional parties have acted as coalition kingmakers, supplying Speakers and Union Ministers and providing votes for government survival.

nc5320d74437.s:
Consider the following statements about regional parties:
1. They can improve representation of backward regions and promote balanced development.
2. They may encourage parochialism and instability.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc5320d74437.x: Regional parties can improve backward-region representation and balanced development, but may also encourage parochialism and instability.

ncf1594f401c.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Telugu Desam Party leads the ruling coalition with the support of the:
ncf1594f401c.x: The TDP leads the ruling coalition in Andhra Pradesh with support from the BJP.

n4ec63fb7321.s: Under the seat-based route, a party becomes a State Party by winning one Lok Sabha seat for every ____ seats allotted to the State.
n4ec63fb7321.x: A party qualifies by winning one Lok Sabha seat for every 25 seats allotted to the State.

n598243237cf.s:
Consider the following statements about recognised political parties:
1. Their candidate needs only one proposer for nomination instead of ten.
2. They may have up to 40 star campaigners, against 20 for an RUPP.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n598243237cf.x: A recognised party needs one proposer instead of ten and may have up to 40 star campaigners; an RUPP needs ten proposers and has 20.

n660e6c207ee.s: A registered unrecognised political party (RUPP) must contest at least once in ____ years or face delisting.
n660e6c207ee.x: An RUPP must contest at least once in six years or it may face delisting.

n8dc580918a2.s:
With reference to donations to RUPPs, consider the following statements:
1. Donors giving above Rs 2,000 must be disclosed.
2. Any donation above Rs 2,000 must come by cheque or bank transfer.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n8dc580918a2.x: Donor disclosure applies above Rs 20,000, not Rs 2,000; donations above Rs 2,000 must be by cheque or bank transfer.

n10ced97f45b.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the TDP and the YSRCP are both:
n10ced97f45b.x: TDP and YSRCP are recognised State Parties in Andhra Pradesh; neither has National Party status.

n2593cf120df.s: The report of a Joint State Public Service Commission is laid before each concerned State Legislature by the:
n2593cf120df.x: A JSPSC reports to each concerned Governor, who lays the report before the relevant State Legislature.

n9f750b56015.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 318 – Expenses of the Commissions charged on the Consolidated Fund
Article 319 – Regulations on conditions of service
Article 322 – Bar on holding office after ceasing to be a member
Article 319 – Bar on holding office after ceasing to be a member
n9f750b56015.x: Article 319 bars holding office after ceasing to be a member; 318 covers conditions of service and 322 expenses charged on the Consolidated Fund.

na4ef2d55a3f.s: The strength of the UPSC and of a State PSC is determined, respectively, by the:
na4ef2d55a3f.x: The Constitution does not fix the strength; the President decides it for the UPSC and the Governor for an SPSC.

n75553f1ba48.s:
With reference to the advice of the UPSC, consider the following statements:
1. The advice is advisory and not binding.
2. Action taken without consulting the UPSC is invalid for that reason alone.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n75553f1ba48.x: UPSC advice is advisory, and a decision taken without consultation is not invalid merely because consultation was omitted.

nindian-polity-52-45.s:
Consider the following statements about the Finance Commission:
1. It is constituted by the President every five years or earlier.
2. The qualifications of its Chairman and members are prescribed by the President.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-52-45.x: Under Article 280 the President constitutes it every five years or earlier, but Parliament prescribes the qualifications (Finance Commission Act, 1951).

nindian-polity-52-15.s:
Consider the following statements about the Finance Commission:
1. It consists of five members, including the Chairman.
2. It has 22 members, 15 from the Lok Sabha and 7 from the Rajya Sabha.
3. Parliament prescribes the qualifications of its members by law.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-polity-52-15.x: The Finance Commission has five members and Parliament prescribes their qualifications; the 22-member description fits the PAC.

n3e3721b28ac.s: Which criteria were newly added by the 15th Finance Commission?
o: Contribution to GDP and forest cover
n3e3721b28ac.x: The 15th Finance Commission added demographic performance and tax effort as new criteria.

n3b96d4962e0.s:
With reference to Special Category Status for Andhra Pradesh, consider the following statements:
1. It was promised in Parliament in 2014.
2. It was included in the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n3b96d4962e0.x: SCS was promised in Parliament in 2014 but not included in the AP Reorganisation Act; the Centre offered special assistance instead.

n515fc48a186.s: Under the Sixteenth Finance Commission, the shares of the five southern States in the States' pool:
o: Rose only for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
n515fc48a186.x: All five southern States gained under the Sixteenth Finance Commission, e.g. Karnataka 4.131% and Tamil Nadu 4.097%.

n38e6246cbf8.s: The salary of the CAG of India, charged on the Consolidated Fund, is equal to that of a:
n38e6246cbf8.x: The CAG gets a salary equal to a Supreme Court judge's, charged on the Consolidated Fund of India and not subject to vote.

n3b3a3480a76.s: Who represents the CAG in Parliament?
n3b3a3480a76.x: No Minister represents the CAG in Parliament; audit reports reach it through the constitutionally prescribed channel.

n6bd8833440c.s: Who was the first Comptroller and Auditor General of India?
n6bd8833440c.x: V. Narahari Rao was the first Comptroller and Auditor General of India.

n4f1fd55bf8a.s: Who is the Comptroller and Auditor General of India in 2026?
n4f1fd55bf8a.x: K. Sanjay Murthy is the CAG of India in 2026.

nd552171421b.s: The CAG is currently auditing how many cities for ease of living?
nd552171421b.x: The CAG is auditing 101 cities for ease of living, including urban-mobility concerns.

nb98e183dfa0.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the three principal Union audit reports of the CAG?
o: Report on the Estimates of Expenditure
nb98e183dfa0.x: The three Union reports are on Appropriation Accounts, Finance Accounts and Public Undertakings; a report on estimates is not one of them.

nindian-polity-80-17.s:
Consider the following statements about the CAG:
1. The CAG has no power to disallow expenditure.
2. The CAG can itself impose punishment for irregular expenditure.
3. The CAG cannot enforce recovery.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-polity-80-17.x: The CAG cannot disallow expenditure, enforce recovery or punish; he only reports to the legislature.

nindian-polity-80-60.s: Which of the following pairs regarding post-retirement employment is correctly matched?
o: Chairman of the UPSC – Can head commissions after retirement
Judges – Cannot take any job after retirement
Chairman of the UPSC – Cannot take another government job after retirement
Judges – Barred from heading commissions after retirement
nindian-polity-80-60.x: The UPSC Chairman cannot take any further government job after retirement, whereas retired judges often head commissions and tribunals.
